title: Customer Care Academy — Net Energy Metering and Other Company Programs
content:
These answers state how Net Energy Metering interacts with the meter opt-out, demand response battery dispatch and budget billing, and with the loss of legacy grandfathering.

**Rules.** Holding a Non-Communicating Opt-Out Meter excludes net metering until the customer returns to a communicating meter. A battery enrolled in a demand response battery dispatch program may export during demand response events, and that export earns the normal export credit; the demand response incentive is paid separately and never reduces or replaces the export credit. Budget billing on the service agreement does not change export credits; credits applied to a bill reduce the actual charges that budget billing compares with its installment. A legacy agreement that loses grandfathering moves to the rider open for new applications for the customer's class.

## Questions and answers

**A customer has a Non-Communicating Opt-Out Meter and asks about net metering.**
Net metering is excluded while the opt-out meter is held; it becomes available once the customer has returned to a communicating meter.

**A battery enrolled in a demand response battery dispatch program discharges to the grid during an event. Does that export earn credit?**
Yes. It earns the normal export credit, and the demand response incentive is paid separately; the incentive never reduces or replaces the export credit.

**The customer is on budget billing. Are export credits smaller or larger because of the plan?**
Neither. Budget billing does not change export credits. The credit applied to a bill lowers the actual charges, and it is those reduced actual charges that budget billing compares with the installment.

**Where does a legacy agreement go when it loses grandfathering?**
To the rider open for new applications for the customer's class.

## Summary

| Holding alongside net metering | Effect on Net Energy Metering |
|---|---|
| Non-Communicating Opt-Out Meter | Net metering excluded until return to a communicating meter |
| Demand response battery dispatch | Event exports earn the normal export credit; incentive paid separately |
| Budget billing | Export credits unchanged; applied credit reduces the actual charges compared with the installment |
